description: Hybrid escalation policy for decisions matrix. Prevents indefinite defer chains by ratcheting requirements as escalation_count grows. Designed by rkit:design-validator (Cycle 3 council).

rules.count_1: WARN — override_reason recommended but not required.
rules.count_2: FAIL unless override_reason >= 80 chars AND final_revisit_by present.
rules.count_3_plus: Defer prohibited. decision must be adopt | partial_adopt | reject.

rationale: Cycle 2 ended with 5 defer items (3 in transitional carry-over chain). Indefinite cycle-N escalation undermines governance — each defer must move toward resolution. count=2 (2 cycles deferred) demands explicit accountability (override_reason + hard deadline). count=3 (3 cycles deferred) forces a terminal decision.
